channel.title: Verasail Insights
channel.description: Practical articles on agentic AI workforces, AI agents, orchestration, compliance monitoring and AI transformation.

item.title: What is an agentic AI workforce?
item.description: An agentic AI workforce is a team of AI agents that plan, act and hand off work alongside people. Learn how it works, what it needs and how to start.

item.title: AI agents for product management: what they do well and where people lead
item.description: How AI agents support product owners and product managers: backlog refinement, user stories, prioritization input and stakeholder updates, with people deciding.

item.title: AI agents for portfolio management: visibility without the reporting grind
item.description: How AI agents help portfolio managers track initiatives, surface dependencies and risks, summarize status and support capacity decisions across the portfolio.

item.title: AI orchestration hub explained
item.description: What AI orchestration is, why multiple AI agents need a hub, and what to look for: routing, workflow sequencing, human approvals, observability and control.

item.title: AI compliance monitoring: continuous oversight for human and agent work
item.description: How AI compliance monitoring works: continuous policy and control checks, exception alerts, audit-ready evidence and oversight of both human and AI-agent work.

item.title: The proactive AI service desk: fixing issues before a ticket exists
item.description: A proactive AI service desk agent spots early signs of trouble, then triages and resolves issues before a ticket exists. How it works and how to adopt it.

item.title: Retraining knowledge workers to orchestrate AI agents
item.description: How to retrain knowledge workers to orchestrate AI agents: shift from menial to meaningful work, build judgment and oversight skills, and learn on real work.

item.title: AI transformation strategy and roadmap
item.description: A practical AI transformation strategy and roadmap: assess processes and data, prioritize use cases, pilot agents, govern, train people and scale in stages.
